sentences.text: 4. The prosecution story is based on the written report of the informant who is the father of the victim.

In his written report, the informant (P.W.-1) has stated as under:
"On 03.06.2020 at about 05:30 P.M., Guddu Jha, son of Devchandra Jha (this appellant) lured his two and half years old daughter and took her away on his motorcycle and threw her near Rajaun bridge after raping her.
After search the informant found his daughter near Rajaun bridge."
Patna High Court CR. APP (DB) No.135 of 2025(5) dt.07-10-2025 5.
Learned counsel for the appellant submits that the prosecution witnesses in this case are not consistent and the conviction of the appellant is not likely to be sustained.
He is in custody since 04.08.2020.

6. On the other hand, learned Additional Public Prosecutor for the State submits that the prosecution witnesses have deposed that it was this appellant who had taken away the victim girl with him and later on she was recovered in seriously injured condition.
The medical examination report proved by the doctor (P.W.-6) has disclosed that there was complete perennial tear involving anal sphincter up to 2 cm.
The doctor opined that there is evidence of sexual penetration along with physical assault on the patient.
Exhibit-P-9/P.W.-6 has been referred to.

7. Having regard to the kind of evidences available on the record particularly the medical evidence proved by the doctor (P.W.-6), given the condition of the victim girl, we are of the opinion that the appellant would not deserve suspension of sentence and release on bail.
Prayer is refused.

8. It is made clear that the observations made Patna High Court CR. APP (DB) No.135 of 2025(5)
dt.07-10-2025 hereinabove are only prima-facie and tentative for the purpose of suspension of sentence and bail only which would not cause prejudice to the either parties.

9. List this appeal for hearing on its turn.
(Rajeev Ranjan Prasad, J) (Sourendra Pandey, J) aditya/-
